description: This file defines an interface 'SortOption' for representing sorting options in search results, including methods for creating, modifying, and retrieving sort entries, as well as generating string representations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SortOption instance with specified entries.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of sort entries.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a propertyPath with order to the sort options and returns a new instance.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a predefined SortOptionEntry to the sort options and returns a new instance.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the sort option.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the sort option has no entries.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a Stream of the sort entries.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the sort option.
